motivation: The round-2 frozen PSAN uses atom dropout 0.2 while the matched dense mixer has no filter dropout, and round-2 factorial runs showed lower Macro F1 with dropout under the 30-epoch budget. This follow-up gives the matched dense control and a no-dropout PSAN arm the same validation-only screening, replicates the round-2 selected settings over seeds, replicates the M32/M64 OFAT axis, and repeats the external architecture benchmarks at 128 pixels, where F=40 exceeds M=16.
prior_exposure: canine common-preset test results of all round-2 runs, including PSAN AD0 versus matched dense (seeds 42-44)
canine seed-42 validation-selected test results of the eight round-2 arms
canine seed-42 OFAT M32/M64 test results
MedMNIST+64 common-preset test results of PSAN/GFNet/AFNO

ofat_replication.initialization: non-filter tensors copied from an untrained PSAN M16 built from the same seed (round-2 OFAT donor rule)

canine.c0_reuse: a selected c0 final reuses the hash-verified identical common-preset run in results/training

external.dermamnist_c128: corrected lesion-disjoint rows of results/external_data/dermamnist_c64_*_identity.csv mapped to the official 128-pixel rasters by official split and index

precision: float32 tensors; CUDA matmul TF32 off; cuDNN convolution TF32 default
objective: highest best-epoch validation Macro F1; ties use earlier candidate order

statistics.ci: paired percentile bootstrap over visual groups (canine), lesions (corrected Derma) or images
statistics.across_seeds: crossed bootstrap of evaluation groups and seed indices; seed-level paired t descriptive

checkpoint_retention: best.pth kept; resume-only last.pth deleted after a completed run to bound disk use
concurrency: up to two jobs per GPU; wall-clock times are contended and not reported as cost
